name: California

llcReport.title: File Statement of Information
llcReport.deadline: Within the anniversary month and the 5 months before it, every 2 years

penalty.note: Franchise Tax Board penalty for failing to file the required Statement of Information.

corpReport.title: File Statement of Information
corpReport.deadline: Within the anniversary month and the 5 months before it

penalty.note: Franchise Tax Board penalty for failing to file the required Statement of Information.

entityTax: Corporation franchise/income tax; $800 minimum franchise tax for LLCs and corporations

permitFee.note: There is no fee for a seller's permit; CDTFA may require a security deposit.

agency.name: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration

penalty.note: 10% of the tax due for a late return or payment.

unemployment.note: No current official penalty amount for a late wage report was found in the state agency's published sources.

newHire.note: $24 for each failure to report a hire or rehire on time, or $490 if the employer and employee conspire not to report.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Penalty assessment of $1,500 per employee when a stop order is issued (Labor Code 3722); repeat offenders face the greater of twice the unpaid premium or that amount.

paidLeave.title: State Disability Insurance and Paid Family Leave (employee-funded)
paidLeave.description: Employers withhold SDI from wages and report it with the quarterly payroll return (DE 9).

local.title: City business tax certificate
local.description: Every California city levies a business license tax; unincorporated areas use the county. Fictitious names are filed with the county clerk.

industry.alcohol: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control
industry.childCare: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing
